deadline.value: December 1 deadline for matriculation the following Fall term
deadline.quote: The application deadline for matriculation the following Fall term is December 1st. For example, applications for Fall 2027 MUST be COMPLETED by 11:59 PM EST on December 1, 2026.

gre_general.value: GRE is not a required component of the application.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is NOT a required component of the application.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Biomedical Sciences subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Faculty are organized in Interdisciplinary Groups; choosing a mentor before applying is not required.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students are supported through graduate assistantships.
funding.quote: All applicants are considered for Research Assistantships, which provide a tuition waiver and a stipend.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from four-year bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: A four-year bachelor’s degree, a three-year bachelor’s plus a master’s degree, or a three-year bachelor’s plus completion of first year of the master’s program from a recognized institution by the Association of Indian University (AIU) or All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).

fee_waiver.value: ILS is not able to provide application fee waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: ILS in NOT able to provide application fee waivers. Please refer to the UGA Graduate School regarding fee waivers (https://grad.uga.edu/admissions/application-fee/).
